story.title: Lumi the Blue Dinosaur
story.prompt: A gentle storybook illustration of a friendly small blue dinosaur named Lumi, wearing a cheerful yellow backpack, standing in a sunny, dappled forest with soft moss, ferns, and glowing fireflies. Warm light filters through tall green trees.

continuation.title: Lumi Crosses the Rainbow Bridge
continuation.prompt: A gentle storybook illustration of Lumi the friendly small blue dinosaur, wearing her cheerful yellow backpack, stepping happily onto a shimmering rainbow bridge arching over a clear sparkling stream in the sunny dappled forest. Soft moss, ferns, and glowing fireflies surround her; warm light filters through tall green trees.

count.title: 数三个苹果
count.message: 好呀，我们来数三个苹果。每个苹果点一下，只数一次。

chatExit.message: 好呀，我们聊聊天吧！你今天最喜欢做的事情是什么？

hands.title: Rock Paper Scissors
hands.message: Choose rock, paper or scissors for one round!
hands.followUp: I'll pick at the same time as you!
